# Pragma

> Cadence is a deep real-time brain that learns from experience.

Pragma is building the brains for robots that keep improving throughout their working lives. Robotics is the first proposed market. The product direction is a supported Cadence runtime and a brain prepared for a customer's embodiment, beginning with a paid evaluation on one adaptation or recovery task.

Cadence uses recursively coupled populations that settle and learn together. Bounded observer-like, self-reading patches carry local state and records, communicate through ports, read represented activity and prediction errors, and participate in feedback and repair. Their jointly settled state supplies the answer.

## Company and product

- [Cadence](https://floatingpragma.io/cadence/): architecture, code and simulation evidence.
- [Robotics](https://floatingpragma.io/robotics/): proposed evaluation programme and changed-wheel rover experiment.
- [Investors](https://floatingpragma.io/investors/): proposed $4 million seed round over 18 months.
- [Investor deck](https://floatingpragma.io/investors/deck/): eight-slide company presentation and PDF.
- [Founder](https://floatingpragma.io/selected-works/): Bernhard Mueller's selected work.
- Contact: bernhard@floatingpragma.ai

## Code and evidence

- [Open-source core](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence): GPL-3.0-or-later Python package.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/docs/DRSN.md): recursive state-and-error observation within one coupled settlement.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): build a small brain.
- [Learning and memory](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/docs/LIVE.md).
- [Package](https://pypi.org/project/cadence-net/): install cadence-net.
- [Cadence preprint](https://philpapers.org/rec/MUECAP-2).
- [Doom evidence excerpt](https://floatingpragma.io/evidence/cadence/doom-confirmations.json): two reserved Basic-scenario evaluations, source hashes and verification records.
- [CartPole evidence excerpt](https://floatingpragma.io/evidence/cadence/cartpole-confirmations.json): 180 held-out episodes at the 500-step limit with supplied-state teaching.

Simulation evidence establishes bounded behavior under the stated conditions. Physical robot adaptation, a useful advantage from recursive depth, broad retention and electrical energy advantages require separate tests. Evidence excerpts are compact source projections, not complete reproduction bundles.

## Research origin

Observer Patch Holography (OPH) asks whether bounded observers can build a shared physical account from local records, overlap comparison and repair. Its organizing idea inspired Cadence; cortical cooperation supplies another computational inspiration. Formal proofs establish consequences of specified assumptions. A physical or biological interpretation requires its own evidence.

- [Research overview](https://floatingpragma.io/physics/).
- [Research explainer](https://floatingpragma.io/watch/).
- [Paper library](https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/): HTML, PDFs and current publication metadata.
- [Scientific source](https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography/).
- [Book](https://oph-book.floatingpragma.io/).
- [Interactive lab](https://oph-lab.floatingpragma.io/).
